india.one_line: India unveils homegrown AI models as regulators warn of AI‑driven financial fraud.

themes.title: IndiaAI Mission launches three models
themes.text: The IndiaAI Mission introduced three domestically built foundation models—EKA‑1 (26.3 billion parameters, 22 Indian languages) and Dhīr 2B and Dhīr 5B (open‑source multilingual assistants for on‑premise and offline use).

stories.headline: IndiaAI Mission unveils three indigenous AI foundation models

themes.title: I4C alerts fintechs to AI fraud
themes.text: India's Cyber Crime Coordination Centre issued an advisory urging banks, NBFCs and fintech firms to guard against AI agents exploiting unpatched software and payment APIs, recommending CERT‑In measures, transaction limits and six‑hour incident reporting.

stories.headline: India's cyber agency warns banks and fintechs of AI-driven fraud attacks
I4C warns Indian banks and fintechs of AI‑led cyberattacks
